notes.title: Various additions
notes.content:
[h1]Survival Dungeon[/h1]
You can enter the dungeon from the dungeon select menu.
Challenge yourself to survive as long as possible in a dungeon that goes on forever, while managing the parameters of satiety and sanity, which are not in the main story!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/5a64538de819bf98d9cb97a0e053a9b1bc6cc43e.jpg[/img]

[b]New Bosses and Enemies[/b]
New enemies appear only in the survival dungeon.

[b]Points[/b]
Best points are recorded for each style.
Points earned in survival dungeons can be exchanged for wallpaper and other items at the "Point Shop".

[h1]Additional Elements of Stages[/h1]
[b]New combo "Flame Array"[/b]
Damages enemies on both sides.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/87aefe22dc39efa69f3f7329e3eb1097804999b1.jpg[/img]

[b]New magic "Ice Pillar"[/b]
Attacks any one grid.

[b]New Relic "Mercury Drops"[/b]
Damage can be inflicted by physical contact.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/25aa59b06a1e90a48c0802fd0408e26246b7bfca.jpg[/img]

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
Adjusted some UI to be easier to read.
Fixed typos.

notes.title: Adjustments and future updates
notes.content:
[h3]Adjustment details[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced the effect of some Relics
[*] Only Builder raised the cost to 7.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/37512e36775e72fa4e718c34cd1e9a1cf2d3bfa0.jpg[/img]

New Action
Added "Bomb".
When you set Bomb + movement action, this action attacks the grid at the destination of the movement. The action does not move at this time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/73f729941cb32dc01681b1d3c59596b63a196213.jpg[/img]

New Relic
Added "Burning Finger"
Defeating a burning enemy ignites their behind as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/e39b6434e2595e1532206320fc70c771a5274d34.jpg[/img]

Added "Explorer's Shoes"
At the end of actions, the last grid treasures will be automatically retrieved.

[h3]Future Updates[/h3]
I am considering a major update, which will likely be a few months away
[list]
[*] Addition of high difficulty dungeons, bosses, and enemies.
[*] Addition of combos and magic
[*] Addition of home skins
[/list]

This is an update, so there will be no additional fees.
Thank you for your continued support of Doll Explorer!

notes.title: Development Progress Report 02
notes.content:
Happy New Year!
This is PicoGames.

I'd like to report how this game will change from the prologue.

[h3]Addition of magic[/h3]
This time, the witch Tia will accompany Doll.
MP can be used to move dolls, attack enemies, and expand the scope of the strategy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/cfd1c5b59346206e2c0aa6cb4df087cd041f26dd.jpg[/img]

[h3]Randomly draws commands, which can be stocked or discarded[/h3]
Each time a command is executed, the power of the bond between Tia and Doll is accumulated.
When the gauge is full, The player can recover MP or get new commands at random.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/b214108beef75393af56dfcd76ee719cbc9575c7.jpg[/img]

[h3]Randomly picking up a Relic from a treasure chest[/h3]
While exploring a dungeon, you may find a treasure chest.
"Relics" that provide various benefits appear at random from treasure chests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/945cc9f86762580b5a568602e03a66d98524d888.jpg[/img]

[h3]Stage selections for camping, stores, and taking on strong enemies[/h3]
The dungeon offers many forks in the road to the finish line.
The player can choose to take the long way around in smaller stages, or take risks in the search for treasures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/350a26162f5dda0771b00dcf6f4d7966c80d977b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Growth elements to be performed on the home screen[/h3]
Tia and Doll's goal is to earn money and get back their repossessed family property.
Recovering the family property will enhance the abilities of both of them.
Enhancement on the home screen is a permanent effect.

I'll report back as development progresses.

notes.title: Development Progress Report 01
notes.content:
Happy Holidays!
This is PicoGames.

I will report progress from time to time.
Before that, I'd like to report how this game will change from the prologue.

[h3]Elimination of game over with one mistake[/h3]
This time Doll has HP and can withstand several attacks from traps and enemies.
HP can also be recovered or permanently enhanced.
When HP reaches 0, there is no retry or undo, and the player returns to the home.
All the money and materials that the player earns in the adventure can be brought back even if the game is over in the middle of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/f13edb124afa2a8f1d9447bb20fec8c007d6f3ac.jpg[/img]

[h3]Poison gas coming from behind every turn[/h3]
In the prologue version, there was a turn limit, but there is none in this version.
Instead, poison gas approaches from behind each turn, one square at a time, and if Doll comes in contact with it, Doll will be damaged.
You get more money if you clear the game in shorter turns.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/ecc1d2eaad38db30fb14de07786267afd95f87e4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Combos activated by combining commands next to each other[/h3]
When certain commands are placed next to each other, the power is increased.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/cf6cef927459e4749872fd2cdb803e5befd08ab2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Addition of "search" commands in addition to movement and attack[/h3]
The "Search" command, which was not available in the prologue version, will be added.
Searching for enemy corpses and treasures on the stage will allow you to acquire various items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43134030/0ba81635a438add8aaaa57bd8d7e4166f3b5fce6.jpg[/img]

I'll report back as development progresses.
